description:
A thermal generator, such as a fossil fuel or nuclear generator, that can start-up again from a *hot*, *warm*, or *cold* state.

`ThermalMultiStart` has a detailed representation of the start-up process based on the time elapsed since the last shut down, as well as a detailed shut-down process. The model is based on "Tight and Compact MILP Formulation for the Thermal Unit Commitment Problem.". For a simplified representation of the start-up and shut-down processes, see `ThermalStandard`.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

status.description: Initial commitment condition at the start of a simulation (`true` = on or `false` = off).

bus.description: ID of the bus that this component is connected to.

active_power.description: Initial active power set point of the unit. For power flow, this is the steady state operating point of the system. For production cost modeling, this may or may not be used as the initial starting point for the solver, depending on the solver used.

reactive_power.description: Initial reactive power set point of the unit.

rating.description: Maximum AC side output power rating of the unit. Not to be confused with base_power.

prime_mover_type.description: Prime mover technology according to EIA 923.

fuel.description: Prime mover fuel according to EIA 923.

active_power_limits.description: Minimum and maximum stable active power levels.

reactive_power_limits.description: Minimum and maximum reactive power limits. Set to `null` if not applicable.

ramp_limits.description: Ramp up and ramp down limits.

power_trajectory.description: Power trajectory the unit will take during the start-up and shut-down ramp process.

time_limits.description: Minimum up and minimum down time limits.

start_time_limits.description: Time limits for start-up based on turbine temperature.

start_types.description: Number of start-up based on turbine temperature, where `1` = *hot*, `2` = *warm*, and `3` = *cold*.

base_power.description: Base power of the unit for per unitization.

time_at_status.description: Time the generator has been on or off, as indicated by `status`.

must_run.description: Set to `true` if the unit is must run.

title: ThermalMultiStart
